Due to persistent signal interference, a direct flight corridor between Station Alpha and Station Beta is unavailable.
Furthermore, a routing protocol mandates that precisely one of the following two flight paths must be incorporated into the inspection circuit: the corridor between Station Beta and Station Gamma, or the corridor between Station Gamma and Station Delta.

The objective is to determine the most efficient closed-loop flight trajectory that inspects each station exactly once before returning to the point of origin.
